p local-id

This meeting is the third meeting of the

93 AI

8B. The

session focused on two main topics

the progress of the AI project and pre

parations for the upcoming demo on the 17th. Mu Guangyuan shared his resear

ch on large model memory systems, including a three-module system based on

the Lightman paper. Wang Yixi demonstrated the progress of the data pipelin

e module, covering document conversion, chunking, and vector database stora

ge. The team also discussed UI improvements, technical issues discovered du

ring code integration, and the timeline for the demo PPT submission.

p local-id

26d58d0f128a

PlanSharing

strong

Plan Sharing

strong

p local-id

01e0e123b6a0

Mu Guangyuan

Shared his research on optimizin

g large model memory systems. He introduced a cost-effective three-module s

ystem

information filtering, topic segmentation, and compression

based on

the Lightman paper. The system uses small models for information extractio

n and an attention-based mechanism for topic block segmentation, featuring

an innovative

artificial sleep

update mechanism for memory optimization.

He also introduced a pluggable memory system as a lightweight external memo

ry maintenance plugin applicable to various projects.

p local-id

0e99d44210ba

Wang Yixi

Demonstrated the progress of the da

ta pipeline module. The current test version

without large model integrati

on

can convert documents into a unified document model and process queries

with relevant information and relevance scores. She also shared several te

chnical issues discovered during code integration, including inconsistent P

DF parsing results, code structure optimization suggestions, and interface

adapter implementation.

p local-id

ea5925b46efd

Vincent

Proposed multiple UI improvements, in

cluding page layout optimization, adding statistical data displays

e.g., h

it count, total count

, modifying the logo, and adding a high-level archite

cture diagram for the PPT. He emphasized that UI design is critical for the

judges

impression during the demo. He also confirmed the timeline for the

PPT draft submission next Thursday and discussed the allocation of the 8-m

inute presentation time.

96ebe7229a2b

, adding

ent suggested using an AI-generated logo.

The team acknowledged the l

sensus was reached to prioritize structured file formats such as Word, Exce

l, and HTML, and to lower the priority of PDF optimization unless it become

s a significant requirement during future integration with other project gr

oups.

p local-id

03dea695967d

The team agreed t

o clean up test and redundant code

e.g., local JSON search, evaluation mod

ules

to avoid mixing with core functionality, ensuring clear and maintaina

ble code.

47bdd88b463b

Demo Preparation

The team confirmed that Wang

Yixi will prepare the first draft of the PPT by Thursday, with a total pre

sentation time of 8 minutes covering both the demo and PPT explanation.
